主要内容: On February 9, 2017, The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. completed a public offering of $1.5 billion in senior notes. The offering included $500 million in 1.800% Senior Notes due 2020, $500 million in 3.150% Senior Notes due 2027, and $500 million in 4.150% Senior Notes due 2047. The notes are governed by the Indenture dated November 5, 1999, between the company and U.S. Bank Trust National Association. The 2020 Notes mature on February 7, 2020, with interest payable on February 7 and August 7 of each year. The 2027 and 2047 Notes mature on March 15, 2027 and March 15, 2047, respectively, with interest payable on March 15 and September 15 of each year. The company may redeem the notes at any time, with the 2020 Notes redeemable at any time, the 2027 Notes redeemable prior to December 15, 2026, and the 2047 Notes redeemable prior to September 15, 2046, each with a make-whole premium and accrued interest. The company may also redeem the 2027 and 2047 Notes on or after the specified dates at 100% of the principal amount plus accrued interest.
